show_hn.story_text: Hi HN! I built a tool to make it easy to explore interaction nets visually in the browser. Interaction nets are a model of computation based on local graph rewriting. I found it hard to visualise how they worked, what sorts of programs you can express with them, what shape those programs take, and what executing programs actually feels like in practice.
